title: nan
authors: Wang F.; Sun K.; Wang Y.
key_contribution: Presents RWA-YOLO, a vision-based object detection and 3D multi-view geometric localization system for UAVs in indoor GPS-denied environments with low light, achieving sub-centimeter positioning accuracy.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
